title: precheck calls a check whose output holds only a SyntaxError a failing premise, since python prints no Traceback header for one, so a check with a literal backslash n in its python -c text passed the plan and was refused at land
goal: bl_precheck tells a check whose output holds a SyntaxError (or any line starting with SyntaxError:, IndentationError: or TabError:) from a failing premise, saying the check is broken, as it does for a Traceback
repro_reason: precheck runs a sprint's checks through backlog.py with no hook to plant an output; only the source can be read cheaply
